name: pohotlivyj professor
source:
Lustful Professor is an adult-only visual novel. In this game, you are in the role of a university professor who lives an ordinary life. But one day a student comes up to him and asks for help. After that, his life changed dramatically...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2060510/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Lustful Professor》是一部仅限成年人游玩的视觉小说。你将扮演一位过着平凡生活的大学教授。某天，一名学生前来向他求助。从那以后，他的人生发生了翻天覆地的变化…

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2060510/]Steam[/url]]
